item.title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
item.description:
OnTrack provides a live monitoring system that watches an LLM agent’s actions as they happen, using a structure‑aware optimal transport model to detect deviations from a safe plan. It builds a streaming comparison engine that flags risky moves in real time, allowing immediate corrective intervention. The result is reduced cost and safety risk because problems are caught before irreversible actions are taken.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud infrastructure, here is what to do: 1) integrate OnTrack into your LLM‑driven incident triage pipeline to monitor agent decisions as they occur; 2) set up alerts for any step that deviates from the expected safe path; 3) configure a fallback script that automatically halts or corrects the agent when a risky deviation is detected.

item.title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
item.description:
The paper tackles the latency of LLM decoding by pruning weights based on a Hessian calculated during decoding, reducing memory reads. The authors built a pruning method that re‑computes the Hessian on the model’s own generated tokens, avoiding distribution shift and achieving faster inference with little loss of accuracy. This is directly relevant to cloud infrastructure managers who run LLMs, offering a way to cut inference costs and improve throughput.

IT Breakdown: If you manage LLM inference, 1) add a Hessian‑aware pruning step before deployment, 2) use the model’s own generated tokens to compute the Hessian during a short calibration run, 3) prune weights and re‑deploy the slimmer model to cut memory bandwidth and latency.

item.title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
item.description:
The paper proposes a system that lets large language model (LLM) agents adapt to changes in credit rules without rewriting the core model. They built a dual‑loop engine that confines self‑modification to a runtime harness—just the instruction text, tool‑calls, and primitive composition—while keeping model weights fixed. The result is a safe, traceable way to evolve the agent with an admission gate that records a hash‑chained change log and a test before deployment.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud infrastructure for AI services, here is what to do: 1) isolate LLM changes to a runtime harness so that the core model weights stay immutable; 2) implement an admission gate that hashes the harness changes, stores the hash chain, and runs automated tests before rollout; 3) ensure every change has an associated diff, cause, and test record for audit purposes.

item.title: [News] Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
item.description: Google DeepMind has unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier intelligence model that promises substantial improvements in reasoning and contextual understanding. The release indicates a shift toward more advanced AI capabilities that could soon be integrated into Google’s suite of productivity tools.

item.title: [News] Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
item.description: Microsoft Research has unveiled a machine learning system that can predict space‑weather events affecting power grids 30‑60 minutes in advance. The technology could improve resilience for critical infrastructure relying on GPS and satellite communications.

item.title: [News] Introducing SynthID Bio
item.description: Google DeepMind has unveiled SynthID Bio, a proof‑of‑concept system that watermarks AI‑generated protein sequences without compromising their biological functionality.

item.title: [News] New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
item.description: Microsoft has announced new data innovations that leverage AI to surface unique business knowledge within organizations. These updates extend Azure and Microsoft 365 data services, enabling deeper contextual analytics for internal operations.

item.title: [News] Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot
item.description: Microsoft has launched a revamped Copilot featuring Home, Code, and Autopilot modules that integrate deeply with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Azure services. This update equips IT engineers with advanced AI-driven automation for building, customizing, and scaling enterprise applications directly within familiar Microsoft tools.
